seed_scheme: NumPy SeedSequence([root_seed,distance,seed_index]).spawn(4) in order: Stim background, Poisson, one burst, independent.
kernel: 0.5 exp(-Euclidean center-to-site distance / xi), in data-qubit spacings
density_units: expected burst cores per data qubit per round
injection: X flips before first H of extraction round; conditional site draws independent; uniform on-patch data-site cores and uniform rounds; overlapping X flips XOR
controls: no bursts; exactly one core per shot; independent site-round X flips with same marginal odd-flip probabilities as the Poisson model at each d and xi
decoder: ordinary PyMatching compiled only from provisional background simple_uniform DEM; decoder input is packed detectors only
pairing: Within each seed/case all conditions reuse Stim background detectors and observable. Within an exposure all xi reuse centers and uniform draws. Distances use independent seeds.
timing: Inference only, warm decoder, same batch sizes; timing is descriptive.
artifacts: seeds-*.npz store failures in little-endian order, keyed by exposure and xi, and counts of Poisson cores per shot; see replication.csv for seed-index keys.
